review.algorithm_assessment: Keep original append/wrap operations in chronological order and toggle their active state through cancellation-chain roots. Appending maps top-level component count c to c+1 and substring count z to z+c+1; wrapping maps c to1 and z to z+1. A four-coefficient affine transform composes these effects. Segment-tree point toggles update the exact current answer from the initial(c,z)=(1,1), without rebuilding bracket strings.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
